title: Exam Room
description: Design a system where students enter an exam room and sit in the seat that maximizes the distance to the closest person.
pseudocode:
1. If seats are empty, sit at 0
2. Find interval with max distance to nearest neighbor
3. If multiple, pick smallest index
4. Update list of occupied seats

steps.note: Second student arrives, occupies seat 9 (furthest from 0).
Third student arrives, max distance is between 0 and 9, sits at 4.
Fourth student arrives, max distance between 0 and 4 is 2.
